WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS customer_count
  FROM Accounts AS a
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT customer_count * 1.0 / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM state_shares
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT sc.customer_count, ss.share, ss.share - av.avg_share AS excess
  FROM state_counts AS sc
  JOIN state_shares AS ss ON ss.rowid = sc.rowid
  CROSS JOIN average_share AS av
  WHERE ss.share > av.avg_share
)
SELECT SUM(customer_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess)
FROM qualifying
